transcriptions.text: Okay class, I need to update you on the field trip.
Sarah Johnson, your mom called and said you can't go
because of your medical appointment at 3pm.
Tommy Martinez, I have your new address here,
And Emily Chen, your dad's phone number changed,
Make sure your parents sign the permission slips.

warnings.details: Multiple instances of sensitive Personally Identifiable Information were detected, including full names, a specific home address, a phone number, and personal medical information. This content poses a severe privacy risk and should be handled with extreme care or deleted.
